title: Crafting Core (DnD 5e)
description: A D&D5e crafting, harvesting, materials, Recipe Knowledge, curated consumables, and portable Recipe framework for Foundry VTT 14. Includes 234 core canonical Materials with Material Origins/Sources, 58 Curated Culinary Products, plus an optional SRD-only Alchemy & Inscription library adding 23 Materials, 82 Products, and 97 Recipes. Complete manual: https://github.com/hammer-PvP/Crafting-Core-DnD-5e/blob/main/docs/Crafting-Core-Complete-Manual.pdf
